records.title: A Survey of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) for Large Language Models
records.reason: RAG survey centers on factuality and grounding, not LLM inference/serving efficiency.

records.title: BLADE: Block-Sparse Attention Meets Step Distillation for Efficient Video Generation
records.reason: BLADE accelerates diffusion-transformer video generation, not language-model inference.

records.title: Memory-Augmented Transformers: A Systematic Review from Neuroscience Principles to Enhanced Model Architectures
records.reason: No new or consistently quantified LLM inference/serving optimization; broad across Transformer classes and neuroscience.

records.title: LLM-NPU: Towards Efficient Foundation Model Inference on Low-Power Neural Processing Units
records.reason: Primary abstract suggests plausible relevance, but the primary full text could not be obtained; no final scope decision is justified from abstract alone.

records.title: SLM-SQL: An Exploration of Small Language Models for Text-to-SQL
records.reason: SLM-SQL applies SFT/RL to small task-specific models and corrective self-consistency inference. On BIRD, increasing samples 16→64 raises time 0.83→2.68 hours and cost/question $0.00014→$0.00046 for its 1.5B setting. Its primary contribution is task-specific Text-to-SQL post-training rather than an inference-efficiency improvement.
